scope: Adversarial: find a documentation claim that CONTRADICTS current code, with file:line on BOTH sides.
mandate: Read-only. Lookup doc claim, lookup matching code, report exact divergence.

primary_finding.doc_claim: CLAUDE.md:274-279 states: 'BranchScope global appliqué sur 11 models post iter11+12 : Order, FrontendOrder, OrderItem, OrderPayment, KioskMachine, StockLevel, StockMovement, CashDrawerSession, CashMovement, PendingPaymentConfirmation, PushNotification, DiningTable, Printer' — and 'User model exempté pour éviter Sanctum recursion'.
code_reality: grep 'addGlobalScope(new BranchScope' app/Models/*.php returns 20 DECLARING models (not 13 listed, not '11 models')

Declaring models: CashMovement, CashDrawerSession, DeliveryBoyCashMovement, DiningTable, DeliveryBoyCashSession, FrontendOrder, ItemBranchAvailability, KioskMachine, Order, PaymentTerminal, OrderItem, OrderPayment, Printer, PendingPaymentConfirmation, StockLevel, PushNotification, PosParkedOrder, OrderQuote, User, StockMovement
User.php:10 imports BranchScope, User.php:90 declares `static::addGlobalScope(new BranchScope())` — this CONTRADICTS the 'User model exempté' claim
Customer.php has NO BranchScope declaration — the Sanctum-recursion exempt is Customer, per BranchScopeCoverageSentinelTest.php:48 EXEMPTED_MODELS list
tests/Feature/Branch/BranchScopeCoverageSentinelTest.php is the CI-locked baseline naming Customer (not User) as Sanctum-recursion exempt
ItemWizardProfile uses WizardProfileBranchScope (nullable variant per app/Models/ItemWizardProfile.php:16-23) — a documented architectural variant not mentioned in CLAUDE.md §9
primary_finding.contradiction_proof: CLAUDE.md says: (a) 11 models, (b) User exempted; CODE says: (a) 20 models declare BranchScope, (b) User DECLARES BranchScope (User.php:90), Customer is the recursion-exempt one (BranchScopeCoverageSentinelTest:48).
primary_finding.recommendation: Rewrite CLAUDE.md §9 BranchScope paragraph to: 'BranchScope global applied to 20 models (current baseline locked by tests/Feature/Branch/BranchScopeCoverageSentinelTest.php). 11 V1.0.2 baseline exemptions documented in the sentinel (FrontendDiningTable, ZReport, AuditLog, OrderDiscountLog, Message, DiningTableAuditLog, KioskPromo, UpsellRule, ActionLog, DomainEvent, plus Branch self-ref and Customer Sanctum-recursion). User model declares BranchScope (User.php:90); Customer model is the Sanctum-recursion exempt.'

secondary_findings.doc_claim: CLAUDE.md:283 says Sanctum TTL 480 minutes (8 hours).
secondary_findings.code_reality: config/sanctum.php:51: `'expiration' => env('SANCTUM_TOKEN_EXPIRATION', 480),`. This matches §1 but BRAIN.md §1 line 24 states V1.0.1 plans 'Sanctum TTL 8h → 1h sensitive ops' which is NOT YET implemented. CLAUDE.md §9 should note this is current vs future.
secondary_findings.contradiction_proof: Code = 480 min (8h) consistent. Drift is in V1.0.1 roadmap divergence (BRAIN says 'planned 1h', CLAUDE doesn't flag the planned hardening).
secondary_findings.recommendation: Note V1.0.1 plan in CLAUDE.md §9: 'TTL 480 minutes (V1). V1.0.1 hardening plan: 1h sensitive ops; see BRAIN §1.'
